Notes. Spread is shown from each team’s perspective (negative = favorite). Conditions: completed games show the recorded temperature and wind; upcoming games show an hourly forecast for kickoff. Wind over 10 mph is flagged (!). Weather forecast data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). H2H and playoff history are franchise-level since the h2h_since season (relocated franchises carry their history). Close games are this season’s games decided by fewer than 5 points. Red Zone figures use plays snapped inside the opponent’s 20: points are touchdowns, field goals and conversions on those plays; trips are distinct drives with at least one such play. Explosive-play rows are omitted from the red zone (a 20-yard pass from inside the 20 is only possible as a touchdown). Passing yards are gross (sack yardage excluded). Avg Box Faced / Used comes from FTN charting on run plays. QB 4QC = comebacks won / times trailing entering the 4th quarter. A Stuff is a run stopped for exactly 0 yards, credited to each defender with a tackle on the play; losses are counted in TFL. Tkl is combined tackles (solo + assisted). The Defensive Line table is ordered by sacks, then TFL, then tackles (switch with the dl_rank_by parameter). nflverse labels most edge rushers as linebackers, so any LB-labeled player with at least 3 sacks + QB hits who is listed OLB, or whose pass-rush production is at least 30% of his tackle count, is grouped with the Defensive Line and tagged EDGE. Small gray ranks (1st–32nd, T- for ties) appear beside points, 3rd-down %, success rates and explosive plays: offense ranks high-to-low, defense ranks fewest-allowed first, and totals are ranked per game played so bye weeks don’t count against a team.
